name: garmin_guide
description: How to work in Garmin Connect (workouts and training data): its screens and the sign-in link. Call this first.

arguments.name: task
arguments.desc: What you want done in Garmin Connect, in your words.

name: garmin_status
description: Check that your Cotlet.dev account and Garmin Connect are ready: account, credits and Garmin Connect connection.

name: garmin_open
description: Open a Garmin Connect page in your signed-in Cloud Browser (default https://connect.garmin.com) to work with workouts and training data.

name: garmin_read
description: Read the current Garmin Connect page: its text and numbered buttons, links and fields.

name: garmin_click
description: Click a numbered element on the current Garmin Connect page.

arguments.name: element
arguments.desc: Element number from the last read.

name: garmin_type
description: Type text into a numbered field on the current Garmin Connect page.

arguments.name: element
arguments.desc: Field number from the last read.

name: garmin_close
description: Close the Garmin Connect browser session when the work is done, so credits stop running.
